recipes.title: Onion & Pecorino Romano Spaghetti

items.i: Pecorino Romano, grated, plus extra to serve
salt and plenty of black pepper

steps: Thinly slice the onions. Cook them in the olive oil with a pinch of salt over medium-low heat until very soft.
Add the butter and black pepper and keep cooking until golden and caramelised, then add the garlic for a minute.
Pour in the stock, grate in the Pecorino, then blitz everything in a blender until smooth.
Cook the spaghetti in salted water until al dente.
Add the spaghetti to a pan with a splash of pasta water and the onion sauce and toss until glossy and creamy, adjusting with more water or sauce.
Finish with more Pecorino and black pepper.
recipes.notes: Adapted by the creator from a Thomas Straker recipe. The video gives no amounts, so quantities and macros are estimates. Use vegetable stock to keep it vegetarian.
